Rust translates their bodies correctly, but compute_no_oracle_canvas measures only positive maxima and uses Graphviz placeholder rectangles as proxies for Java's drawn TextBlock/LimitFinder envelope. It then mixes document-margin replacement with fixed SVEK and chrome tails. Diagnostics show the theme width is owned by the WebApp-to-Database center-label placeholder at x=126.236332 after the left margin, whereas Java computes the SVEK dimension from the complete painted min/max span before TextBlockExporter12026 adds the outer margins. A constant-only substitution can make the four fixtures green, but breaks the source-level margin invariant and the existing asymmetric-margin perturbation; that experiment is rejected. Cerulean's missing gradient remains explicitly outside this mechanism.
